children: Novartis AG (SIX:NOVN) posted mixed results: remibrutinib hit Phase III relapsing MS endpoints and will be presented at MSTORONTO2026, while setbacks include pausing YTB323 after patient deaths and a failed cardiovascular Phase III; the firm also licensed Hybrozyme and plans Basel site changes impacting staff.
: Novartis: remibrutinib met primary endpoints in Phase III REMODEL trials for relapsing MS, cut relapse rates vs teriflunomide, fewer brain lesions, favorable safety; data heading to MSTORONTO2026.
: Novartis AG (NOVN) paused its experimental CAR-T therapy program YTB323 (rap-cel) after three patient deaths were reported; UBS analysts characterized the program as high risk in a research note.
: Novartis (NOVN) said a Phase 3 cardiovascular trial missed its primary endpoint: treatment did not lower heart attack or stroke risk, marking a setback for its cardio program.
: Novartis (NOVN) licensed Alteogen's Hybrozyme (ALT‑B4) to develop injectable IV formulations, with options for exclusive rights and potential payments up to $3.22B in milestones and royalties.

: Novartis will move Kleinbasel lab work to Basel campus and European biologics sites, end small-scale biologics production by 2027, impacting ~200 staff with ~130 Swiss job cuts and support measures.

title: Weekly Recap: remibrutinib REMODEL win and YTB323 halt after three deaths
